slow_internet.solution: Try restarting your router, moving closer to it, and checking if other devices are using bandwidth.

app_crashing.symptom: The app keeps crashing on startup.
app_crashing.solution: Update the app to the latest version, clear cache if possible, and restart your device.

software_crashing.symptom: The software keeps crashing on my computer.
software_crashing.solution: Update the software to the latest version and restart your computer.

wifi_not_connecting.solution: Check if Wi-Fi is enabled, restart your router, and reconnect using the correct password.

login_issue.symptom: I can't log into my account.
login_issue.solution: Verify your credentials, reset your password if needed, and check if your account is locked.

printer_not_working.solution: Ensure the printer is powered on, check for paper jams, and verify the correct printer is selected.

slow_computer.symptom: My computer is running very slow.
slow_computer.solution: Close unused programs, restart your computer, and scan for malware or viruses.

restart_router.solution: Please restart your router and check if the problem persists.

reset_network_settings.solution: Try resetting your network settings. Instructions are available in your system settings under 'Network Reset'.

check_cables.solution: Ensure all network cables are securely connected.

isp_contact.solution: If the issue continues, please contact your Internet Service Provider (ISP) for further assistance.

clear_cache.symptom: Web pages are not loading correctly.
clear_cache.solution: Clearing your browser cache can sometimes resolve connectivity issues.
